text:
maya: Hey team — we need to prebook buffer GPUs for next quarter. Forecast shows a 3x spike in dedicated pool usage for inference tests in us-west-2 and a smaller burst in eu-west-1. Can infra ops request reservation/quota increases now?

liam: +1. Do we have exact numbers? also need network ENI and NAT gateway limits checked for eu-west-1.

sophia: Draft numbers from forecasting:
- baseline dedicated a100 units: 40
- expected peak (2 weeks/month): 120
- buffer/headroom target: additional 30 (to cover cross-team spike)

infra-bot: FYI — current account quotas: GPUs (A100): 48 in us-west-2, 16 in eu-west-1. ENIs: 500 per region, NAT gateways 10.

maya: So we need a reservation in us-west-2 for at least 100 A100-equivalent slots and a quota bump in eu-west-1 to 48. Also request transient burst capacity for two weeks each month.

liam: For cloud ticket, we should split into: 1) soft-reservation (reserved capacity product) for committed monthly, 2) quota increases for ephemeral burst. Finance needs estimate. tom can you run cost calc?

tom: Quick calc: committed reservation for 80 A100-months at current list ~= $X/month (I'll attach spreadsheet later). Ephemeral bursts priced at pay-as-you-go — rough add'l = ~$0.9/token? jk, will paste numbers.

sophia: Also request expanded ENI quota in eu-west-1 to 800 and a VPC route table increase — some customers hit the 50 routes limit last week. Add that to ticket.

maya: I'll draft the cloud support case. Proposed message: 
```
Hello account team,
We are Redwood Inference, account ABC-123. We request the following changes across regions: 
1) us-west-2: increase GPU quota (A100 equivalence) from 48 -> 150 and reserve capacity 80 units for monthly committed pool (start 2025-05-01). Enable temporary burst to 300 for two weeks per month.
2) eu-west-1: increase GPU quota from 16 -> 48, ENI limit from 500 -> 800, increase route table entries per VPC from 50 -> 200.
Please advise required account approvals and lead times. Attaching workload profile and forecast.
Regards, Maya
```

liam: LGTM. Add request to allow cross-region fallback to g4dn/g5 if A100 not available (compatibility note).

infra-bot: Created internal ticket INFRA-8421 for pre-approval and cost review. Suggested next action: get procurement signoff and open cloud support case (use template infra/quota-template.md).

maya: Filed cloud support case: CS-2025-55873. Keeping this thread for updates.

tom: Procurement reviewed tentative numbers. Need ROI: how much cheaper is reserved vs on-demand for our expected utilization? I'll send a short memo by EOD.

liam: Also flag this with eng-sre: autoscaling policies need to respect reserved pool; add config: `reserved_pool: true` in serving runtime. Small snippet: 
```yaml
pools:
  - name: dedicated-a100-usw2
    reserved_capacity: 80
    burst_capacity: 220
```

sophia: Note on timeline: cloud approval for large quota bumps has 7-14 day lead in eu region historically. Plan for 3-week buffer.

maya: Thanks. Next steps: (1) tom sends cost memo, (2) I update cloud case with fallback models and route increases, (3) liam coordinates with eng-sre on runtime flags.

liam: ack. @sophia can you own the ENI/route table follow-up with cloud ops?

sophia: on it. opening subtask INFRA-8421-2.

infra-bot: Update: cloud case CS-2025-55873 -> initial response received, asked for confirmation of account owner and business justification.

maya: I replied with justification and attached forecast CSV. Will post cloud case updates here.

tom: posting cost memo: https://redwood-internal/drive/costs/dedicated-reservation-memo-2025.pdf :thumbsup:

liam: Perfect. If cloud approves, we should schedule the rollout during low-traffic window (first weekend of month) and test fallback behavior.

maya: Agreed. Keeping this thread concise — will update when cloud case moves to provisioning.

sophia: quick note: consider asking for spot capacity fallback in us-west-2 as a cheaper emergency buffer.

liam: good call. add to case.

infra-bot: Thread archived into INFRA-8421 after last update.
